Blizzard Planning More 1v1 Options In Overwatch - TechRaptor
I think the slow and steady rate that Overwatch is adding features is awesome. Especially testing character changes and game modes in PTR before they go live for everyone.
Agreed. They have this stuff down to a science at this point and are beyond confident in their abilities.

And it's much easier to demo character changes on a testing server and let the community detect issues in real matches before they go live.

Lots of games just pull the trigger on a balance change and then have to release an immediate follow-up change to correct a balancing issue they didn't anticipate.

I don't really mind Blizzard adding additional content, but I'm not exactly sure whether a 1v1 mode really has much of a place in what is supposed to be a team-based shooter. In a worst-case scenario, you would get drama about the balance and skills of certain characters that pose no problem in group matches but do so in 1v1 fights, with enthusiasts for either mode screaming for the character to be adapted to their liking. Kinda like with the PvP/PvE drama in World of Warcraft.

Good point. The arcade mode doesn't amount to much more than a fun distraction from the main game, that's true. Because it is a team class-based shooter, theres not much to do with characters perfectly balanced for the main game. I dont think it detracts from the overall game, though, and am down for more.

It could also be a sign that they are ready to pivot their IP into different games and genres moving forward, imo.
